subject.title: [Feature]: Allow max allowed file attachments on discord messages

question: Should OpenClaw accept the native Discord multi-attachment delivery shape proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99515 for this issue?
rationale: The remaining choice is user-visible delivery semantics, not just implementation mechanics, because batching changes grouping, overflow follow-ups, reply targeting, and receipt/progress aggregation.

options.title: Accept the linked delivery shape
options.body: Land the linked Discord-owned batching path after normal current-head checks and close this issue from the merged pull request.

options.title: Require narrower semantics
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask the linked pull request to adjust grouping, overflow, reply, or progress behavior before merge.

options.title: Reject native batching for now
options.body: Close or defer the linked pull request and keep this issue only if maintainers still want a different future design.

recommendation.title: Accept the linked delivery shape
recommendation.body: Land the linked Discord-owned batching path after normal current-head checks and close this issue from the merged pull request.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest visible history on the Discord outbound/media path and already reviewed this exact issue context.
